observations.definition: Broad NCSL category includes in-person absentee and primarily mail voting states; precise procedures differ.
Broad NCSL classifications; voter-specific eligibility and election types must be checked.

limitations: Cross-state summaries are a research index rather than legal advice.
2026 changes and litigation may supersede published classifications; individual state current rules require primary-source confirmation.
Absentee, mail, early in-person and ID requirements are separate policy dimensions.
